defaults.x: Accessible & Ethical, Inclusive Design, Neighbourhood Warm
defaults.d: none needed: a booking inbox and diary are enough
defaults.c: Cool, soft neutrals with one clear action colour; calm without hospital glare
defaults.t: Practitioner names with registration numbers, first-visit steps, prices, step-free access, privacy note
defaults.b: Online booking for new and returning patients; phone as the fallback

rows: Medical Clinic
gp, surgery, clinic, doctor, appointments, family medicine, registration, walk in
Put opening hours, how to register and how to get urgent help in the first screen. Use plain language, say how to book without a smartphone, and never display patient data in examples.
Pharmacy/Drug Store
pharmacy, chemist, prescriptions, repeat, vaccine, medicines, opening hours
Repeat prescription ordering and today's hours are what visitors want. Show the pharmacist in charge, delivery rules and which services need an appointment.

rows.t: Registered pharmacy number, pharmacist name, delivery policy, opening hours

rows: Dental Practice
dentist, dental, check up, hygienist, braces, emergency tooth, nhs, private
Show new-patient booking, emergency appointments and prices openly. Introduce the dentists by name and registration, and describe a first visit so nervous patients know what happens.

rows.a: Book a check-up or emergency slot

rows: Veterinary Clinic
vet, veterinary, pet, surgery, emergency, vaccination, neutering, animals
Give the out-of-hours emergency number the same weight as booking. List the vets, species treated, and how payment and insurance work.

rows.a: Book a visit or call for an emergency

rows: Physiotherapy Clinic
physio, physiotherapy, rehab, injury, back pain, sports injury, treatment, referral
Match visitors to the problem: back, knee, sport, after surgery. Show the therapist's registration, session length and price, and whether a referral is needed.
Chiropractor
chiropractor, spine, back pain, neck, adjustment, treatment plan, clinic
Describe what a first appointment involves and what you will not claim to treat. Show registration, session length and cost, and how many sessions a typical plan holds.
Optician / Eye Care
optician, eye test, glasses, contact lenses, frames, optometrist, vision
Book the eye test first; browse frames second. Show test price or NHS eligibility, lens options in plain words, and a clear returns and adjustments policy.
Massage Therapy
massage, therapist, sports massage, deep tissue, relaxation, treatment, wellness
List treatments with length and price, therapist qualifications and a short health form note. State the professional conduct line clearly and keep the tone calm, not suggestive.
Childcare/Daycare
nursery, childcare, daycare, preschool, ofsted, early years, fees, places
Parents look for safety first: inspection result and date, staff ratios, safeguarding lead and a booked visit. Never use children's photos without recorded consent.
Senior Care/Elderly
care home, elderly, senior, domiciliary, respite, dementia, carers, family
Often a family member is reading in a hurry. Write plainly, give a human to call, show inspection ratings with dates, fees and what a first assessment is.
Beauty/Spa/Wellness Service
spa, beauty, facial, treatments, wellness, salon, relaxation, booking
Price the treatments with length, show the therapists, and keep gift vouchers findable. Avoid before-and-after claims that cannot be backed.

rows.x: Organic Biophilic, Soft UI Evolution, Local Service Clear

rows: Hair Salon / Barber
hair salon, hairdresser, barber, barber shop, haircut, hair, beauty, colour, styling, salon, walk in, stylist
Booking by stylist and service is the page. Show prices from, how long each takes, and real work from this chair. Say whether walk-ins are welcome.
Nail Salon
nails, nail salon, manicure, gel, acrylics, nail art, beauty, salon, pedicure, appointment
List treatments with time and price, including removal and repairs. Show your hygiene practice and a gallery of your own work.
Tattoo Studio
tattoo, artist, flash, consultation, piercing, aftercare, portfolio, studio
Group the portfolio by artist and style. State the age rule, deposit, hygiene registration and aftercare. Let people enquire with a reference and placement.

rows.x: Craft Workshop, Brutalism, Anti-Polish / Raw Aesthetic

rows: Therapist / Counsellor
therapist, counsellor, therapy, counselling, anxiety, couples, online sessions, accredited
Say who you work with and what a first session is like. Give fees, session length and accreditation. Keep colours calm, avoid stock photos of people in distress, and give crisis lines.
Mental Health App
mental health, mood, anxiety, support, wellbeing, self help, therapy app, crisis
Show crisis resources before any sign-up, state clearly what the app is not, and keep data promises in plain words. Calm colour and no streak guilt.

rows.d: Mood and activity summary the user controls
rows.t: Clinical advisers named, privacy summary, crisis line, data export
rows.b: No booking: sessions with human therapists link out
